an9.26:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca candikāputto rājagahe viharanti veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
an9.26:1.3: tatra kho āyasmā candikāputto bhikkhu āmantesi:
an9.26:3.3: yato ca kho āvuso bhikkhuno cetasā cittaṃ paricitaṃ hoti tassetaṃ bhikkhuno kallaṃ veyyākaraṇāya
an9.26:3.4: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti.
an9.26:3.5: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ candikāputtaṃ etadavoca:
an9.26:3.6: “na kho āvuso candikāputta, devadatto bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:”
an9.26:3.7: yato kho āvuso bhikkhuno cetasā cittaṃ paricitaṃ hoti tassetaṃ bhikkhuno kallaṃ veyyākaraṇāya
an9.26:3.8: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī’ ti.
an9.26:3.9: evañca kho āvuso candikāputta devadatto bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
an9.26:3.10: ‘yato kho āvuso bhikkhuno cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno kallaṃ veyyākaraṇāya
an9.26:3.11: ‘khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmi’ ti. dutiyampi kho …pe…
an9.26:4.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā candikāputto bhikkhu āmantesi :
an9.26:4.2: devadatto āvuso bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
an9.26:4.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhuno cetasā cittaṃ paricitaṃ hoti, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno kallaṃ veyyākaraṇāya
an9.26:4.4: ‘khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī’ ti.
an9.26:4.5: tatiyampi kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ candikāputtaṃ etadavoca:
an9.26:4.6: na kho āvuso candikāputta, devadatto bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
an9.26:4.7: yato kho āvuso, bhikkhuno cetasā cittaṃ paricitaṃ hoti, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno kallaṃ veyyākaraṇāya
an9.26:4.8: khīṇājāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti.
an9.26:4.9: evañca kho āvuso candikāputta devadatto bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
an9.26:4.10: yato kho āvuso bhikkhuno cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno kallaṃ veyyākaraṇāya
an9.26:4.11: ‘khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī’ ti.
an9.26:5.1: kathañca āvuso bhikkhuno cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti:
an9.26:5.2: vītarāgaṃ me cittanti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.26:5.3: vītadosaṃ me cittanti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.26:5.4: vītamohaṃ me cittanti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.26:5.5: asārāgadhammaṃ me cittanti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.26:5.6: asandosadhammaṃ me cittanti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.26:5.7: asammohadhammaṃ me cittanti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.26:5.8: anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ kāmabhavāyāti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.26:5.9: anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ rūpabhavāyāti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.26:5.10: anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ arūpabhavāyāti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.26:5.11: evaṃ sammā vimuttacittassa kho āvuso bhikkhuno bhusā cepi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti. nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti
an9.26:5.12: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañcassānupassati. bhusā cepi sotaviññeyyā saddā …pe… ghānaviññeyyā gandhā …pe… jivhāviññeyyā rasā …pe… kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā …pe… manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti. amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ, vayañcassānupassati.
an9.26:6.2: tassassu aṭṭhakukku heṭṭhā nemassa aṭṭhakukku uparinemassa
an9.26:6.3: atha puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva naṃ kampeyya na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya,
an9.26:6.6: atha dakkhiṇāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva naṃ kampeyya na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya,
an9.26:6.8: gambhīrattā āvuso nemassa, sunikhātattā na sampavedheyya silāyūpassa.
an9.26:6.9: evameva kho āvuso evaṃ sammā vimuttacittassa bhikkhuno bhusā cepi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti. nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti,
an9.26:6.10: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti, ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañcassānupassati.
an9.26:7.5: manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti. nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti.
an9.26:7.6: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ, vayañcassānupassati.
